//: Facts about the live Box API that the vendored specs leave out. See README.md (Spec supplements). Each entry may only add; once upstream declares the same parameter or response, ingestion fails until the entry is deleted.

operations.evidence: Box answers If-None-Match on a web link like on a file or folder: the current etag gets 304 Not Modified, a stale one the web link (live probe, 2026-10-29). box/box-openapi declares neither the header nor the 304 here.

parameters.name: if-none-match
parameters.description:
Ensures an item is only returned if it has changed.

Pass in the item's last observed `etag` value
into this header and the endpoint will fail
with a `304 Not Modified` if the item has not
changed since.

304.description:
Returns an empty response when the `If-None-Match` header matches
the current `etag` value of the web link. This indicates that the web link
has not changed since it was last requested.

operations.evidence: Box answers If-Match on a web link update like on a file or folder: a stale etag gets 412 precondition_failed, the current one updates (live probe, 2026-10-29). box/box-openapi declares neither the header nor the 412 here.

parameters.name: if-match
parameters.description:
Ensures this item hasn't recently changed before
making changes.

Pass in the item's last observed `etag` value
into this header and the endpoint will fail
with a `412 Precondition Failed` if it
has changed since.

412.description:
Returns an error when the `If-Match` header does not match
the current `etag` value of the web link. This indicates that the web link
has changed since it was last requested.
